name: Aura
summary: Dynamic repricing for Amazon and Walmart sellers — automated price strategy across marketplaces.
best_for: Amazon and Walmart sellers past the point where manual repricing costs more attention than it is worth, and whose monthly volume sits comfortably inside one band
skip_if: your catalogue is small or your prices rarely need to move — repricing pays back on competition and volume, and at low volume the $37 is buying automation you could do by hand
honest_knock: The tier is decided by how much you sell, not by what you need. That is unusually honest as a model — a seller doing $10K a month is not subsidising one doing $900K — but it means your bill moves when your business does, in the same month, without you choosing to upgrade. Pass $15K and Starter stops being the plan you are on. Work out which band you land in the way the page measures it: their table says monthly sales are calculated on a trailing two months, so it is a sustained climb rather than a single spike that moves you up. Two smaller things: the marketplace count is a real cap (two on Starter, so Amazon plus one), and the AI listing allowance is per listing rather than per repricing action, so a large catalogue eats it faster than a busy one.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Starter · per month flat per account, but the tier is set by your monthly sales…
pricing.notes: (2026-08-28, checked line by line against their own pricing page; every figure below is the same as on 1 Aug 2026) Flat per account, not per seat, with unlimited listings on every tier. Starter $37/month ($451 a year), Essential $77 ($931), Plus $157 ($1,891), Pro $237 ($2,851) — annual saves 20%. The ladder is set by monthly sales volume, not by features: Starter up to $15K, Essential up to $50K, Plus up to $250K, Pro up to $1M. Marketplaces included: 2, 3, 4 and 6. Aura AI covers 250, 500, 1,000 and unlimited listings; Hyperdrive 10, 25, 50 and 100 allocations; user seats 1, 2, 5 and unlimited. Their table adds three things the earlier reading did not record: monthly sales are calculated on a trailing two months, workflows run 5, 10, unlimited and unlimited, and there is a 14-day free trial.
